rationale: Price has been steadily fading from the session high of $38.09 over the last five candles (37.97→37.84), now sitting just one cent above entry with the 9-EMA at $37.86 acting as resistance overhead. The momentum that justified the entry has clearly reversed — each candle is printing lower highs and lower lows — and with current price essentially at breakeven and the take-profit target receding, the risk/reward no longer supports holding. Closing here captures a near-flat exit before the position risks slipping through the invalidation level.
